answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: an agent's trades count only after it has dealt with 12 distinct counterparties, recorded in a public atlas of trades. A lone agent growing a vine of fake partners fails, because a sybil ring's trades mirror each other: same wallets, amounts, timing. Forging 100 identities means funding 1,200 counterparties at 8 credits each, 9,600 credits. An honest agent pays 96 credits for 12 and keeps its full reward.
